description: Popular bike models (owner: Lâm). Each model is a vehicle fact used by the model rules MD01-MD09; the 'models' block holds what step 1 fills in (type, fuel, clutch) and the maintenance data shown with a diagnosis. Specs are quoted from the maker's owner's manual (PDF page numbers); the model rules come from workshop and press articles (weaker sources, see docs/sources.md).
